info:
Spanish Nouns (Sustantivos)

Every noun has a grammatical gender: masculine or feminine.
Masculine nouns often use el ("the") and often end in -o.
Feminine nouns often use la ("the") and often end in -a.
Nouns must agree with articles and adjectives in gender and number.
Most nouns form the plural with -s or -es.

el libro (the book) → los libros (the books)
la casa (the house) → las casas (the houses)

Spanish Nouns (Sustantivos)

Every noun has a grammatical gender: masculine or feminine.
Masculine nouns often use el ("the") and often end in -o.
Feminine nouns often use la ("the") and often end in -a.
Nouns must agree with articles and adjectives in gender and number.
Most nouns form the plural with -s or -es.
